description: Validates that the project's most recent modeling round was actually validated by validate_alignment.py and reached PASS. Hard in every archetype and not mode-aware: no archetype or collaboration mode can soften it.

checks.description: At least one round report and the latest-round status pointer must exist
checks.remediation: Run model-validatealignment/scripts/validate_alignment.py with --output-dir set to the project's artifacts/Analysis folder

checks.description: The most recent modeling round must have status PASS
checks.remediation: Resolve the findings in the latest alignment report (answer clarification questions, fix or regenerate the affected models), then re-run validate_alignment.py under a new round ID

checks.description: The latest round must cover at least one boundary
checks.remediation: Run the validator with --root or --scope naming the boundary folders modeled in this round

checks.description: The latest round must record the model versions it validated, so later edits can be detected as stale
checks.remediation: Do not hand-write alignment-status.json; it is produced by validate_alignment.py. Before relying on an earlier PASS, run validate_alignment.py --check-stale on its report
